dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, none of these flowers look local to Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Emilie? It's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Hello, you two. Would you like to buy some flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're in charge of this shop?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Yes. I came to Mondstadt to collect a few samples for new scent ideas. But, I wasn't finding anything.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Then, this lady who called herself a mage told me she had a bunch of rare plants she was sure I'd never seen before.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: All I have to do is manage this flower shop, and I get to research these plants all I want.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice! That should help you come up with something new for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: If there's one trait they have in common...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I think it would be the feeling of "summer," refreshing and clear, cutting through the full-bodied and dream-like floral notes.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I certainly have a lot to research, so I think I'll be here for a while. Did you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're looking for things in here that are different from the real Mondstadt. Do you mind if we take a few pictures of these plants?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, since you like them so much, why don't we ask Nicole if you could preserve them in some way?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Really? That would be amazing. This is my payment, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: I never knew origami flowers could give off a fragrance. Fascinating...
